description: This stacked bar chart illustrates the number of experts per layer, broken down into three distinct groups. The horizontal axis represents the categories, labeled "Layer" (which appears slightly blurred), with discrete values ordered sequentially from 1 to 24. The vertical axis represents the value, labeled "Number of Experts," utilizing a linear scale that ranges from 0 to 10 with tick marks and corresponding horizontal grid lines at intervals of 2. The chart features stacked bars for each layer, where each bar is divided into three color-coded segments representing different groups as indicated by the legend at the top center: G0 is represented by blue, G1 by green, and G2 by yellow. The segments are stacked vertically with G0 at the bottom, G1 in the middle, and G2 at the top. Across all 24 layers, the bottom blue segment (G0) maintains a constant value of 1. The middle green segment (G1) and top yellow segment (G2) vary in height across the categories. The tallest overall stacked bar occurs at layer 1, reaching a total value of 9, composed of 1 for G0, 4 for G1, and 4 for G2. The shortest overall stacked bars have a total value of 3, occurring at layers 7, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15, 23, and 24, where each of the three segments contributes a value of 1. The bars are sorted in ascending numerical order by layer from left to right, and there are no visually emphasized bars or annotations.
